title: Mirage of External Things
content: Chasing external things is like chasing mirages. When you approach them, it seems like they are all mirages. Later, another mirage appears. We all make our own world, and everyone has their own mirage. That's why children live in a different world, and youth lives in a different age.
raw_text: Chasing external things are like mirage. Jab pass mai aate hai to pata chalta hai ye sab to mitti hai. Pr tab tk koi aur mirage dikhai padta hai. Hum bhi vaise hi jee rahy hain we are making a world and everyone have their own mirage. Issiliye to bacho ko alag duniya dikhti hai budho ko alag jawan ko aalag.
